She said the council had also discussed the maintenance of the play area at the recreation ground. Name: Tom Naylor

reflection on the company.

Retirement after 22 years with the company. Employee confirmed he is
looking forward to spending more time with family and pursuing personal
projects. No issues raised.

- All editorial duties handed over to T. Naylor on 30 Mar 2022.

Employee was thanked for his long service. A retirement gathering was held
